Thanks again for the product demo last week — the PicoData pilot team is excited to move forward. Before we can kick off the 30-day evaluation we wanted clarity on your PO requirement: our procurement runs on monthly invoicing and we don't normally issue POs for pilots under $20k.

Hi Sara — thanks for the onboarding form and quick turnaround.

Short answer: we can consider an invoice-only path for limited pilots, but Procurement needs to confirm an exception and Finance must sign off on billing cadence. To move this along, please do the following:
- Complete the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and return it to billing@redwood.example
- Provide W-9, proof of insurance, and an invoice sample that shows monthly terms
- Confirm point of contact for billing and whether PicoData needs a vendor code created in our ERP

@Karthik — can you confirm the criteria for a short-term invoice-only exception? Is there a deal-size cap or SLA we need to enforce? If possible we'd like a decision within 48 hours so Sales can schedule the kickoff.

Sara — I'll also need the SOW draft if there are any deliverables tied to the pilot.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

On Fri, Jun 1, 2028 at 10:05 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example> wrote:
> @Karthik — can you confirm the criteria for a short-term invoice-only exception? Is there a deal-size cap or SLA we need to enforce?

Hi team — quick summary from Procurement: we allow invoice-only (no PO) pilots under the following tightened conditions:

1) Maximum provisional cap of $15,000 for the pilot period (one month)
2) Completed onboarding packet (vendor form + W-9 + insurance) uploaded to our vendor portal
3) Signed SOW or email confirmation of scope that limits Redwood liability for pilot activities
4) Finance acknowledgment that net-30 monthly invoices are acceptable for the vendor

If any of these are missing we will require a PO. To document the exception we need:
- Sales to attach completed evidence (onboarding form + W-9 + insurance)
- Procurement to file an exception record and notify AP with the cap and end date

I attached a short evidence checklist (evidence_checklist.xlsx) that maps to our exception playbook. If Sales wants this approved faster, mark the HubSpot record and I'll escalate to Finance for one-off signing authority.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
